title: Prime LO-FI Music
description: LO-FI Music in four Minecraft Music discs
body:
> warning⚠️ 
> This recourse pack has some issues and it's still under the work so please forgive me for any errors



This is a music resource pack that replaces the audio for four specific music discs with calm, custom-made lo-fi tracks. If you want a more chilled-out atmosphere while you play, this is for you.

Where to find them?
I’m not going to tell you exactly which discs have been changed, but here is a hint: I replaced the four "creepy" ones. You'll have to track them down in-game to hear the new vibes.
